description_en: Queries the databases, tables, and columns on which a database account has permissions
description_zh: 获取给定账号可见的库表列
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-account-privilege-objects --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1k3wdmt1390000 --account-name test --privilege-type Column --database-privilege-object database1 --table-privilege-object table1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --column-privilege-object col1 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccountPrivilegeObjects
